name: (a) after the stream is cut the badge shows 'Reconnecting', the browser's own retry (≈3 s) carries Last-Event-ID=<last id seen> (seen on the wire by CDP and by the proxy), and the badge returns to Live
(a) the service replays the frame missed during the drop ('created', id > last id) with no snapshot frames, and the card appears
(b) a 502 to the browser's retry closes the EventSource; the client reopens with ?lastEventId=<last id> after ~1 s (badge 'Reconnecting (1)'), then Live
(b) ?lastEventId= replays the missed frame (created, id > last id) with no snapshot frames
after each recovery the list is reloaded exactly once (useOutageFeed reloads when the stream comes back) and then stays quiet (no reload loop in the 4 s idle window)
